latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of iPhone Add Music — Add Music to iPhone Videos

- Add background music to iPhone video clips (MP4, MOV, M4V, AVI up to 500MB)
- Fast server-side processing (20–40 seconds per video) with 1080p MP4 export
- Automatic cloud API connection and session management, with free anonymous token option
- Simple workflow: upload video, describe result, receive processed download link
- Session-based editing supports batching, iterative tweaks, and user-friendly status updates
- Handy tools for managing credits, tracking session state, and resolving common errors or limitations
